sample_unit: ambulatory clinicians (125 AI scribe users, 478 weighted nonusers)

links.outcome: Clinician EHR time, note time, after-hours documentation time, and encounter closure time after AI scribe use
links.effect: Users had 8.5% lower mean EHR time and 15.9% lower note time versus weighted nonusers; pre-post time to close encounters fell 7.1 hours. No significant difference in after-hours documentation time or appointment volume.
links.quote: In this retrospective cohort study, clinicians using an AI scribe spent significantly less time in the EHR and in notes in both pre-post and propensity score analyses.

screen.reason: Evaluates the impact of deploying an ambient AI scribe on EHR documentation efficiency in real clinical practice, comparing scribe users to nonusers.
